conservative_hold.description: Gentle, long-only accumulation. Buys a small % of cash only when risk is low-to-mid; stops buying by the dead zone. Never sells (sell_max_rate=0). Authored as SdcaCurveShape parameters, not 21 free nodes.

balanced.description: Moderate, long-only accumulation across a wider low-to-mid risk band, tapering to zero at the dead zone. Never sells. Authored as SdcaCurveShape parameters, not 21 free nodes.

aggressive_accumulate.description: Aggressive, long-only accumulation: high buy rates at low risk, decaying through mid risk. Never sells. Authored as SdcaCurveShape parameters, not 21 free nodes.

accumulate_and_distribute.description: Full accumulation + distribution: buys through low-to-mid risk, holds flat through the value zone, sells into high risk. BTC-reference personality encoded as SdcaCurveShape (sell_curvature=2.0 back-loads distribution). Not optimized.

btc_optimized.description: Walk-forward winner (#3174). Not a published digiquant.io number. Re-run with the Nautilus evaluator on real BTC when new history lands. All-catalog extra search (grid 0/0.5/1, 1458 evals) kept no extras. Curve_simulator Stage B with sells enabled. beats_flat_dca_oos is false.
